name: PULSE
tagline: Analyze first. Spot trade or run a guarded Autopilot on your selected network.
taglineZh: 先分析，再在所选网络进行现货交易或运行受保护的自动驾驶。
shortDescription: PULSE turns live OKX Global Market and selected Polymarket evidence into recoverable Quick or Pro reports, then connects valid Global Market plans to owner-signed Spot Trading or guarded Autopilot.
description: PULSE is a multichain Analyze → Spot or Autopilot workflow for humans and agents. Global Market covers OKX-listed crypto, xStocks and RWA instruments; execution independently verifies an identity-safe token representation, settlement asset, live OKX Onchain OS route and wallet balance on X Layer, Base or Arbitrum One. Prediction Market analyzes one explicitly selected Polymarket question read-only. Five public paid services keep discovery clear: two Global Market tiers, two Prediction Market tiers and one Onchain Pre-Trade Risk Guard. Reports are durable and wallet-recoverable. Arc Testnet remains analysis/payment only until Arc mainnet execution support is released.

cdpBazaar.catalog: The same five public report and Risk Guard services; no duplicate ERC-8004 identity is required.

autopilotAiPass.catalogPolicy: An in-product AI entry entitlement, not a sixth public analysis marketplace service.
autopilotAiPass.expiry: New AI-confirmed entries hold after expiry; deterministic monitoring and protective exits continue.

wallet.browser: Reown AppKit, Wagmi and Viem; wallet keys remain client-side
wallet.aspRegistration: Agentic Wallet email login via Onchain OS
wallet.operatorTesting: Server checkout is disabled by default and reserved for controlled E2E verification
wallet.funding: In-app native-to-payment-asset swaps on X Layer, Base and Arbitrum; separate wallet/Gateway USDC balances and Circle Gateway deposit on Arc Testnet
wallet.networkSelection: Last selected enabled network persists across reloads; DEFAULT_NETWORK applies only when no saved choice exists

webExperience.predictionSelection: Single active crypto price/direction market selected from an in-page popup; no separate predictions page
webExperience.predictionReport: Readable confidence, summary, outcome probabilities, bid/ask, evidence quality, market metrics, invalidation, limitations, provenance, and disclaimer; technical JSON is collapsed
webExperience.focusNote: A valid Global Market Buy setup can prefill a Market, Limit or Autopilot action; every Spot signature remains owner-controlled and Autopilot remains policy-bounded
webExperience.themes: Network-aware Base, Arbitrum, and Arc themes with the original X Layer design preserved

arcAi.live: Real xAI market analysis with Arc budget and rate controls
arcAi.fixture: Deterministic payment/job plumbing validation only; no market inference

dataPolicy.polymarket: Public read-only evidence only; no order placement
dataPolicy.selection: User-selected markets only; no silent substitution
dataPolicy.restrictedMarkets: May be analyzed read-only when active and orderbook-enabled; restriction remains disclosed
dataPolicy.paymentSafety: Primary market and required order books are validated before payment and revalidated by the worker
